0.3.3.name: Node
0.3.3.description: The Node class is the basis of every widget in CoshUI.

public-params.id: Sets a unique identifier for the Node.
public-params.width: Determines the horizontal size of the Node.
public-params.height: Determines the vertical size of the Node.
public-params.margin: Sets the space around the Node.
public-params.style: Holds the style of the Node in the form of a CoshStyling object.
public-params.classes: Lets users set reusable styles for Nodes.
public-params.z_index: Determines the render order of a Node.
public-params.mouse_filter: Sets different filter types for the Node's mouse interaction.
public-params.positioning: Determines whether a Node will participate in layout calculations or not.
public-params.x: Only works with positioning set to ABSOLUTE. Sets the Node's x position starting from parent's x position.
public-params.y: Only works with positioning set to ABSOLUTE. Sets the Node's y position starting from parent's y position.

private-params.children: A list of that Node's children.
private-params._was_hovered: A variable that stores hover state for that specific Node.
private-params._x: The real x value that layout calculations and rendering cares about.
private-params._y: The real y value that layout calculations and rendering cares about.
